# bloub animation engine

Unmodified engine files from https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub
at commit `b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749`.

Copyright (c) 2026 Jérémy Perret. MIT; see LICENSE for the original notice.
The original license is also distributed with the desktop static assets.

Ignovate uses this framework-free engine through `components/IgnovateAvatar.jsx`,
which provides brand blue, white eyes, run-state mapping, viewport/visibility
pausing, pointer gaze on the welcome page, and reduced-motion support.
No Vue runtime or remote resource is required. The MIT license covers upstream
code; the upstream project is not affiliated with x.ai.
